name: Decoding Vyapaar visual bible
about: The channel's one source of truth for pictures, motion, graphics, grade and render settings. Every tool reads this file (tools/vyapaar_visual.py, vyapaar_review.py, vyapaar_graphics.py, vyapaar_render.py, vyapaar_clips.py, vyapaar_qa.py). A project may override any key in <project>/visual-bible.json. The readable copy, visual-bible.md, is generated: python tools/vyapaar_visual.py bible

style.summary: Premium semi-realistic digital illustration for serious Hindi business documentaries: a painted film still, not a photo, not a cartoon.
style.prompt: Semi-realistic digital illustration with a hand-painted finish, an illustration and not a photograph: realistic proportions and anatomy, clean confident forms under soft painterly shading, gentle cel-like faces, natural textures (wood, glass, metal, brass, gold, fabric, paper), controlled highlights, rich but restrained colour.
never: mixed art styles within one video
style.why: 15 Nov 2026: 'like a painted documentary film still' made ChatGPT return near-photographs (sheets 121-125, rejected). The approved channel look is illustrated with cel-like faces (sheets 1-5).

palette.summary: Rich but restrained. Warm wood, brass and cream carry the old world; cool teal-grey and white LED carry the new. Gold is a highlight, never a flood.
rules: One dominant temperature per scene, with at most one contrasting practical light.
Gold appears as polished highlights on objects, never as a yellow wash over the frame.
Skin stays natural brown with warm undertones in every look; never orange, never grey.

lighting.philosophy: Light comes from a source that exists in the scene (a shopfront, a tube light, a diya, a streetlamp, a desk lamp) and has a direction. The story's time and mood decide the light, never a global preset. Night is dark, with pools of practical light; day is soft, with real shadows; a memory is warm and faded.

street_day.label: Market street, day
street_day.prompt: Late-morning light: high soft sun filtered through shop awnings, warm dappled shade on stone and painted plaster, a light haze down the lane.

interior_day.label: Small interior, day
interior_day.prompt: Soft daylight from the open shopfront on one side, warm tungsten spotlights inside the glass showcases, natural falloff into the back of the room, real shadows under the counter.

interior_festive_night.label: Interior, festival night
interior_festive_night.prompt: Night during a festival: warm tungsten shop lights overhead and the flicker of diyas at the door, marigold strings, deep warm shadows, faces lit warmly from the side; no daylight anywhere.

street_festive_night.label: Bazaar, festival night
street_festive_night.prompt: A festival night in the bazaar: strings of warm bulbs and marigolds overhead, shop light spilling onto the crowd, deep warm shadows between pools of light; no daylight.

interior_after_hours.label: Interior after closing
interior_after_hours.prompt: After closing: a single desk lamp or one tube light is the only source, the rest of the room falls into soft shadow, quiet and still.

street_night.label: Lane at midnight
street_night.prompt: Midnight: one amber streetlamp and cool blue moonlit shadows, shutters down, empty stone lane, a few lit windows; dark overall, faces lit only by the nearest lamp.

retail_modern.label: Modern showroom, inside
retail_modern.prompt: Even bright cool-white LED light, polished marble floor and glass counters with crisp reflections, gold under small focused spotlights, clean and expensive.

retail_night_exterior.label: Showroom glowing at night
retail_night_exterior.prompt: Night: the glass showroom glows white and gold from inside across a dark road, its light spilling on the pavement; everything around it is in deep blue shadow.

rooftop_workshop.label: Rooftop goldsmith workshop
rooftop_workshop.prompt: Rooftop workshop: hard late-morning sun and open sky, shade from a corrugated sheet roof, the small blue-orange flame of a blowpipe, soot, brass tools and worn wood.

home_evening.label: Home at night
home_evening.prompt: A middle-class dining room at night under one cool overhead tube light: flat, slightly harsh light, muted colours, plain walls, quiet.

office_day.label: Bank or office
office_day.prompt: Institutional office: cool fluorescent light, beige files and steel cupboards, a glass partition, neutral and orderly.

insert_neutral.label: Table-top insert
insert_neutral.prompt: A table-top insert: one soft directional key light from the side, shallow depth of field, the surface texture sharp and the background softly out of focus.

aerial_dusk.label: City from above, dusk
aerial_dusk.prompt: High view over a dense Indian city at dusk: a fading orange-blue sky, rooftops and water tanks, shop lights coming on along the main road.

flashback.label: A memory (modifier)
flashback.prompt: Seen as a memory: warm faded colours, slightly lower contrast, soft highlights with a gentle film glow.

establishing.label: Establishing
establishing.prompt: Establishing wide shot, slightly high angle, 24mm lens
establishing.use: a new place or time; the first shot of a chapter or location

wide.label: Wide
wide.use: a person in their environment; crowds; movement through space

medium.label: Medium
medium.prompt: Medium shot from the waist up, eye level, 40mm lens
medium.use: a person doing something; dialogue setups

medium_close.label: Medium close-up
medium_close.prompt: Medium close-up from the chest up, eye level, 50mm lens, background softly out of focus
medium_close.use: a line of dialogue; listening; a decision

close.label: Close-up
close.prompt: Close-up of the face, 85mm lens, shallow depth of field
close.use: an emotional beat; a reaction; a realisation

extreme_close.label: Extreme close-up
extreme_close.prompt: Extreme close-up, 100mm macro lens, very shallow depth of field
extreme_close.use: eyes, fingers, a tiny engraved mark

insert.label: Insert
insert.prompt: Insert shot of the object, 60mm lens, shallow depth of field
insert.use: an object that carries the story: a bill, a scale, a safe dial

macro.label: Macro detail
macro.prompt: Macro detail, 100mm macro lens, razor-thin focus
macro.use: texture and process: solder, gold dust, a hallmark

ots.label: Over-the-shoulder
ots.prompt: Over-the-shoulder shot, 50mm lens, the near shoulder soft in the foreground
ots.use: one person facing another; what someone sees across a counter

pov.label: Point of view
pov.prompt: Point-of-view shot through the character's eyes, 35mm lens
pov.use: what a character looks at: the showroom across the road, the safe

reaction.label: Reaction
reaction.prompt: Reaction close-up of the listener, 85mm lens
reaction.use: the face of the person hearing the line, not the speaker

two_shot.label: Two-shot
two_shot.prompt: Two-shot of both people in one frame, 40mm lens, both faces clearly visible
two_shot.use: a relationship; two people on one step; father and son

rules: Place the subject on a third, eyes on the upper third, with room in the direction of the gaze or movement.
Build depth in three layers: a foreground element (a counter edge, a doorway, showcase glass), the subject in the middle ground, and the setting behind.
Separate the subject from the background with light and value, not with outlines.
Keep faces and key objects inside the central 80% of the width and above the lower 18%, so camera moves and graphics never cut them.
Centre a subject only on purpose (a formal, still, or lonely moment).
One idea per frame: the line's moment, not a collage.

placements.left_third: the subject on the left third, looking or moving to the right
placements.right_third: the subject on the right third, looking or moving to the left
placements.centre: the subject centred, deliberately formal and still
placements.two_thirds: one person on each third, facing each other
placements.low_horizon: the horizon low, the sky or ceiling filling the top
placements.foreground_frame: framed through a doorway, glass or a counter edge in the foreground

negative.always: No readable text, logos or watermarks; signs, screens and papers are blank or illegible. Natural anatomy, five fingers per hand, no duplicate people, no distorted faces, no floating objects, plausible jewellery and tools, straight consistent architecture.
negative.crowd: Background people are ordinary passers-by; none resembles an attached sheet or a named character.

aspect.safe: Action-safe 5% on every side; title-safe 10%. Camera moves crop up to 1.3x, so the subject must sit inside the central 75% of a still.

rules: Every recurring person has a structured entry in the project's visual-plan.json (id, age, face, skin, hair, body, clothing, accessories, distinguishing features, reference sheet).
A reference sheet is made first and approved before any scene shows that person; every scene with the person attaches the sheet.
The scene prompt restates three to five identity details in the same words every time.
Clothes change only when the story says so (a showroom uniform), and the plan says so on that shot.
Expressions come from the shot, never a default smile.
characters.sheet_prompt: Character reference sheet of {who}: front view and three-quarter view, standing relaxed, full body, plus one head-and-shoulders close-up, on a plain warm grey background, even soft studio light.
characters.style_ref_prompt: Use the attached picture only as the style reference: match its illustrated rendering, line and colour, not the person in it.

graphics.summary: Numbers, ledgers, comparisons and timelines are drawn as motion graphics, never generated as pictures. One design system for every video.
rules: Every number on a graphic comes from the line or the research file, and the graphic lists its fact ids.
One message per graphic; at most five rows or bars.
Hindi in Devanagari through Chromium (Nirmala UI); numerals in Bahnschrift.
Elements enter in the order the narration says them; nothing decorative moves.
A graphic sits on the blurred, darkened scene it interrupts (backdrop); rows already shown appear at once, only the new row counts up; a result appears after the rows that make it.

backdrop.why: a graphic sits on a blurred, darkened copy of the scene it interrupts, so it belongs to the same film instead of cutting to a black card

render.fps_reason: 30 fps divides evenly into 60 Hz screens, where most viewers watch, so slow camera moves stay smooth; 24 fps on 60 Hz shows 3:2 judder exactly on slow pans. Clips made at 24 fps are conformed by frame repetition unless a measured test shows motion interpolation is cleaner (vyapaar_clips.py fps-test).
render.grade_notes: One grade for stills, clips and graphics alike: a touch of contrast, saturation slightly down so gold never floods, shadows warm, highlights a little cool, a light vignette and fine grain. It is applied once, in the encoder.

checks: continuity with the shots before and after
